What Does "Plugged In, Not Charging" Mean with Laptop Batteries?

It could be several things.

  • If the battery is fully charged or very close to fully charged, the charge controller circuit could be turning off the charging to protect the battery.

  • If the battery is not fully charged, the charge controller may not be receiving the proper signals from the battery to show that it is installed or in need of charge.

  • The battery, charger or charge controller could be defective and charging is not possible.

  • Finally, if you're using a non-OEM charger the charge controller could be refusing to charge because it is non-OEM.
